_comment: Version-specific binary facts for the Guest. Loaded at runtime by LiliesGuest (Mods/LiliesGuest/data/binary.json). Every function is armed only if the running EXE SHA-256 is listed below and the bytes at rva match prefix (fail-closed). Only functions without a reflection entry belong here. Verify offline with tools/verify_binary.py.

InputConsume.note: Consumes NextInputSnapshot(+184) into InputSnapshot(+224); the Guest overwrites InputSnapshot after the original runs. IDA.

GameplayCameraUpdate.note: Forced bLag=false so Lily keeps a fixed screen point in the exported frame. IDA.

HPComponentDoDamage.signature: void UHPComponent::DoDamage(this, AActor* From, int32 Damage, bool bJustGuarding, bool bGuarding)
HPComponentDoDamage.note: HP settlement for direct callers (the Guest's Hurt replay on Lily). Ability hits do NOT come through here: AE_Damage inlines the same settlement (see AEDamageApply). IDA + ELMP.

AEDamageApply.signature: void UAE_DamageComponent::ApplyDamage(this, AActor* Instigator, AActor* Target, FHitEntry* Entry)
AEDamageApply.note: Virtual on the AE_Damage effect (vtables 0x14340C888 / 0x14343E618 / 0x14343EA50): computes the hit's damage and writes the target HPComponent CurrHP (+276) directly, then notifies the instigator (OnDamagedEnemy: MP, relics). The Guest measures hits on EM proxies here. IDA.
